description: Stage 3.5 register row P1: per-state, per-anchor baseline of cumulative layout shift (loading presentation first seen to settled), long tasks during the state preparation (the first interaction), and the resolved font. A baseline, not a budget: X3 sets budgets and their tolerance from it. Tier B and C values are diagnostic only.
note: The run was made on the working tree later committed unchanged as implementationHead; runBaseGitHead is the git HEAD the harness read at the time.

environment.browser: Chromium headless via CDP (no npm dependency)
environment.build: production build of src/web/mavi-web served with API fixtures

statusVocabulary.cls: a number when measured; not-applicable when the state holds its loading presentation or never shows one; failed when a loading presentation never cleared; unsupported when the browser lacks the API
statusVocabulary.longTasks: {count,maxMs,totalMs} when the state has a preparation (an interaction); not-applicable when it has none
statusVocabulary.font: resolved platform font face for the Context Bar and for content text when measured
